beaches.name: Huk naturiststrand (Bygdøy)
beaches.summary: A naturist beach lies directly beside the main textile beach at Huk. Oslo kommune's Huk badeplass page lists 'Naturiststrand rett ved' among the facilities; Norsk naturistforbund files Huk under its official beaches and says a narrow bay separates the naturist beach from the textile beach. Neither source cites rules, signage or a decree.

beaches.name: Langøyene naturistområde
beaches.summary: Oslo kommune designates a naturist area on the south side of Søndre Langøyene. The municipal page lists it among the island's facilities; the rest of the island, including the main bathing beach, is not designated. Norsk naturistforbund reproduces a map of the area credited to Bymiljøetaten; neither source mentions signage or enforcement.
